description: R-15: the product's event vocabulary, published as data. Every reported count is derived from records the emitter wrote against this file; no number is typed into a document. Web-side events are declared with their emitter and are not emitted by this API.

meaning.on: append events to the event log
meaning.off: emit nothing at all, write nothing, create no file

storage.format: jsonl, one event object per line, in emission order

prohibited_value_rule: A payload value must be null, boolean, integer, or a string matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,64}$ -- identifiers, modes and counts only, never free text. The rule is enforced at emit time and re-checked from the log by the guard.

events.name: run_started
events.counts: One record per run this instance created, whichever path created it -- the endpoint for a visitor (`initiated_by: user`) and the boot seeder for its own example runs (`initiated_by: seeding`). Without the second the funnel would report more completions than starts, because the seeder writes through the service rather than the endpoint.

payload.dataset_id: string identifier of the dataset row
payload.reasoning_mode: the effective reasoning mode at creation

payload.run_status: the terminal status the row actually reached

payload.mode: findings | audited, for the markdown exports

events.name: starter_question_used
events.counts: A run started whose question equals, after stripping, one of the questions the tracked catalog publishes. The click itself is not counted -- a visitor who opens a starter question and never submits leaves no record -- and neither is a question that merely resembles a published one. The denominator is therefore runs, not clicks.

payload.dataset_id: string identifier of the dataset row
